page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7a.xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 AMD EPYC 7T83 processor running at a base clock speed of 2.55 GHz. The instance is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a contrast between single-core and multi-core capabilities. The instance demonstrates strong single-core CPU performance in stress-ng tests, placing in the top 25%. However, multi-core CPU performance and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression are weak, falling into the bottom 25% and bottom 10% respectively. Memory bandwidth tests show poor performance for large block read and write operations, though cached small-block reads and PassMark memory scores remain in the average tier. Single-threaded tasks like gzip compression and bzip3 decompression also perform at average levels.

Given the high memory density relative to the 4 dedicated vCPUs, this instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-bound workloads that do not require high parallel processing power or local storage. Database operations and redis SET operations show weaker benchmark results, indicating that high-throughput transactional databases may be constrained. The instance is suited for memory-intensive applications with moderate CPU requirements, such as caching layers, lightweight enterprise applications, and single-threaded data processing tasks.
